note: Rugged Ozark refuge land north of Gainesville, with three primitive camping areas, one in each of the area's three zones, each reached by its own road. This entry's camp is in Zone 2, south of the fenced old refuge: a small lot with a privy on the gravel area road in from County Road 107 off Highway 5. There's no clear pad; spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Designated Camping Sites' / 'Individual Campsites'; map shows three Primitive Camping Areas, one per zone, each with a privy and its own entrance (Zone 1 at HQ off Hwy 181, Zone 2 = pin via CR 107, Zone 3 via Hwy Y / CR 116). Free, FCFS, no hookups, 14 days. Two splits proposed (Zone 1 HQ camp 3.1 km, Zone 3 camp 6.75 km). Pin is the GIS point ~130 m into the woods south of the Zone 2 lot; move suggested. Not waterfront kept; phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: the area page lists 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites / Individual Campsites'. The 11/13 map shows three Primitive Camping Area symbols, each beside a parking lot and privy, one per zone. Vehicles are restricted to gravel and paved roads and parking areas. No 4WD note, ford or length limit is published for any zone. Zone 1 (HQ) has a large mowed loop with a gravel loop road ~250 m long, south of the headquarters, that easily fits a 23-ft rig. Zone 2 (this pin) has only a small structure (privy) at a pull-off on the gravel road, with no clear gravel lot visible on leaf-off imagery, so fit there is plausible on the road-side pull-off but unproven. Zone 3 is a gravel lot in a clearing on CR 116.
CONTRADICTION (minor): the 2026-10-13 brochure says 'Campers are limited to 15 consecutive days in a 30 day period'. Regulation 3CSR 10-11.140 on the area page says 14, so 14 is kept.

SPLIT PROPOSED (1): Zone 1 camp at the headquarters, GIS 28 at 36.67553,-92.39265, beside HQ lot 593 (36.67746,-92.39304); 3.1 km from the pin. Own entrance: 'Zone 1 (Inside the fenced portion-Old Refuge): From Gainesville, take Highway 181 north 5 miles, then Caney Mountain Refuge Drive west 0.50 mile to the area headquarters.' Suggested pin on the mowed loop south of HQ, ~36.6762,-92.3928. This is the best-fitting of the three.

SPLIT PROPOSED (2): Zone 3 camp, GIS 380 at 36.71546,-92.46788 (lot 591 at 36.71722,-92.46648, ~230 m NE); 6.75 km from the pin. Own entrance: 'Zone 3 (Outside the fenced portion): From Gainesville, go north on 5 Hwy 10 miles to Hwy Y. East on Y for 2 miles until pavement ends, continue east 1.5 miles on CR 116 to the conservation area.' Gravel county road.
ALTERNATIVE: if AWH prefers one entry, re-point 13782 to the Zone 1 HQ camp (largest, clearest fit, the area's front door) rather than Zone 2.
PIN: stored 36.66526,-92.42547 = GIS camping point 29. It sits in unbroken woods ~130 m south of the Zone 2 road and the lot/privy point 595 (36.66642,-92.42591). Suggest moving to 36.6664,-92.4259.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): small creek bottoms only.
PHONE: (417) 679-2363 on the area page matches.
